description: shortform-superengine hooks. (1) UserPromptSubmit: when the prompt contains one of the skills' trigger phrases, inject one line naming the skill to invoke instead of doing the work by hand. (2) PreToolUse on Bash: SocialCrawl credit guard, cost-gates paid API calls before they spend and hard-blocks the banned transcript endpoints. (3) PostToolUse on Skill and Read: a Skill call of angles, rehooks, hook, polarize or viral opens a slot for that session; a later Read of that skill's method file (references/legit-<name>.md, or rehooks' step3-lines.md in Step-3 mode) in the same session appends the stamp to <project>/reel-build/provenance.md for reel-scripter's gate. (4) PostToolUse on Write, Edit and MultiEdit: when reel-scripter's final script <project>/scripts/<slug>.md (never *.skeleton.md) is written, check its storyboard table and, on a problem, exit 2 with the problems on stderr so the model fixes the file. (5) hooks/goldmine-answer.py on UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse AskUserQuestion and PreToolUse Write|Edit|MultiEdit|Bash|PowerShell: when the user replies to a message holding the Goldmine question word for word, append goldmine-asked: <stamp> to <project>/reel-build/provenance.md and tell the model to record the answer; block a goldmine: asked- write before that line exists, and any goldmine-asked: write. All fail-open (any error -> allow / silent).
